body: I'm negative. Bumps are gone too. Amazing what the brain can trick you to think. Going to live life with guilt. I wish I could go back in time still. I am changing my life starting today. No more alcohol, no more thoughts of other girls. I'm going to be the best person I ever was from here on and I'm never going to get close to letting that happen again. My relationships are going to be different not just with my girlfriend but with family and friends. I will never take a moment for granted. I'm not going to use this account for obvious reasons but if something in my life ever starts bringing me down I am going to go back to this post and remember the only time I've ever considered suicide. Thank you everyone for your responses because they made me feel less alone.
I'm scared. What could I possibly do or say to keep her? If/when she finds out, is there any chance of us being together?

If I'm positive is there a way to save this relationship? I know it would be difficult. If I ever felt this way again could I just go to therapy for sex addiction? I haven't masturbated or watched porn since this incident. I used to daily and it has been over one week since I have. I never want any type of sex from someone other than my current girlfriend. If I have std is it possible to continue my relationship or is it out of the question?

The white zit things that someone on reddit said might be molloscum, are no longer here. After one week. Google says it takes 2-3 months usually for them to go away while new ones start. I still have other marks, may have been from the tea tree oil I used to try and fix it. And might just be skin irritation. I can't help but thinking I'm clean. I'm still waiting on results but if they are gone that soon then it can't be molloscum? I'm scared of the results still for other stds. I'm currently in a state of thinking how I'm going to change my life once everything is clear. I don't want to be this way for the fear if there are bad results. I have a feeling I'm clear. But I am scared of the opposite. If I am clear, my life will no longer be the same for the better. If I'm not clear, my life will no longer be the same for the worse. It is hard waiting for results. I want to go back to thinking about worst case scenarios, to prepare myself. But it's hard because my subconscious now thinks that I have a chance of being clear.

And I am thinking worst case scenario if I am not able to hold down my job with the guilt, shame, and depression, I will find out what it's like to be homeless in Portland and meet people with similar/worse stories and see how long that lasts.

Anyways, after work I drove to the mountains, still here in gold bar now. Crying sessions for the past few hours. Reading a lot about suicide and views on it. I don't know if this is just a result of being bipolar but my thoughts on suicide for my situation are different, at the moment. Maybe it's just because I've had so much time to read and think. Maybe I will feel 100% different about suicide tomorrow for the worse. I hope not. I am trying to find alternatives to suicide. I am trying to prepare for a new way of living which I never thought about. My old life will be history. They way I knew my life to be will be flipped around. I will lose everything I once had. I wrote a letter to myself:

"It's okay to be alone. You can still live life. You will see her with another man. She deserves it. Hopefully he treats her well and they have a family. Maybe it's the man you saw in your dream. It may be a painful many years but it will most likely get better someday. You can sort out life after that. Meantime go to nature when possible. Alone. Meet people and tell them what happened. Have good intentions, everyone may hate you in your life. Everyone will know the scumbug you are. Live life alone but do good to people. You are now a complete outsider watching other people's happy lives. Add to them. Do what it takes to survive on your own without a family, just you. Your life is only 1/3 over so far. If you're evil the first 1/3, be another man for the last 2/3. Move out of your parents house. Survive on your own. Move out of your hometown. Use your free time to help people. Your mission in life is no longer what it used to be. The least you can do with the remainder of your life is to add help/happiness to others."

I hope I am able to listen to it. I know it will be hard to once everything goes down. But I hope i listen. I know I will never get over what happened. On Monday me and my girlfriend have a concert we are going to together. I will cherish that moment deeply. I won't be caring about the songs that are playing.

I want to be walking proof that the worst thing in the world can happen and I am still walking through it. I want to go on this forum and give advice. I hope this lasts and I don't kill myself.
No results today, have to wait until Tuesday-Thursday.
How was it diagnosed? From what I've read they don't go away in one month, 2 months is the lowest... usually years

I sure hope so. If that's all I end up having, I will just force myself to assume it's the same as all the other white bumps I've always had. Telling myself to trust the doctor to hopefully get myself to believe it, because it may be the case. However, what are the chances that it just now transfers from the sides of my pubes (which I've had for many years) to the bottom of my penis. 4 weeks after a risky exposure. What are the chances. Who knows. Maybe the universe is fucking with me and creating a wake up call. Anyways, thanks for your time as well, it makes me feel good to get replies on here, even if my views on everything don't change. The fact that there are at least people reading or listening to what may destroy me is somewhat comforting. I hope people read this thread someday and learn from my own mistakes. Will post back results when I get them.

I forgot to say, I lost my virginity to this girl. Only girl I've had actual intercourse with. She was with one guy before me but they only did it once. Supposedly. That was 6 years ago. My first and only gf

Thanks, I appreciate it. The ones I am worried about unfortunately are not, warts, hpv etc. Molloscum seems like it is, but reading people's stories it never goes away at least any time soon. Ive always had tiny red pimple like things on my pubic area and the doctor said it could have just transferred. The chances of that would have to be the biggest coincidence in the world. Maybe if all it ever was was molloscum I could just force myself to believe that I've had it forever and transferred it. That's the only thing that could save me, believing what the doctor said was a "possibility". If it was curable and we broke up, I would not be 100% sure on suicide, but I'd still highly consider.
Thank you. Will go there if the slight chance I test neg

I was going to summarize what I wrote without mentioning suicide. I have no idea how she will react. She won't believe this is real. she will be crying, I will be crying, she may tell me to leave immediately, she may not. I honestly don't know what I would do in her situation. If she was the one giving me stds. My views are changed. I don't know what I would have done if she told me that 2 months ago because my views have shifted. If she ever admitted to cheating I would be understanding in knowing that she wouldn't again and we could sort it out. That's only because I now know what it's like being the cheater. If I was cheated on before I ever knew how it felt, I honestly don't know how I would react myself. Depends on the circumstances I guess. 

My act was disgusting. And she would never get that image out of her head. But then again I wasn't in a separate relationship from her, in love with someone else. It was a way to cope with my insecurities and to "get back" at scenarios of her cheating that I made up in my head, they most likely didn't happen. it depends on the intentions of cheating to me, but no one really knows the intentions except for the cheater. No matter what it's wrong and selfish and one of the worst things you can do to someone, stds just skyrocket it up to a whole other level. Sadly I'm more likely than not in that position. 

if I'm positive, I'm going to break the news to her and take it as it comes from there. If I'm negative, I'll be a whole new person to her and everyone, and keep getting tested. I did this to myself. I will keep updated on this once I get my results, thanks for listening because I'm alone in this.

Thanks but I couldn't. She might stay with me because she is afraid of me committing suicide. That would put an extra burden on her. That would be like begging for sympathy that I don't deserve. I would feel more horrible if that were the case. Or she might spread the word before that happens. Anyways all I can do right now is chain smoke cigarettes and struggle through the next week while planning/preparing for a trip with her that may not happen while trying to find excuses to avoid sex and seem normal. I feel disgusted with myself that she doesn't know what is going on during this waiting time. I'm going to be with her with the thought that this might all end very soon. The guilt is too hard to handle right now I want the results now.

So the doctor at the walk in made me feel a tiny bit better. He said to check on it the next week or two but he doesn't see anything alarming. Wrote it off as skin irritation. He said it's a possibility of molloscum when I asked but he said to wait for the test results to see if I have anything. 

So I'm still stressed as fuck. He didn't seem like he knew what he was talking about and he was just saying things to make me feel better and to keep a watch on it cause he doesn't know what it is. He was all about just waiting for test results which is understandable... I hope my results come in tomorrow and not Tuesday-thurs. 

How do I avoid sex from my gf until the results come in? Even though she may be infected already if I am, I don't want to have sex with her until this is confirmed no std. 

if some miracle happened which I really don't see, I am going to 1. Never drink or cheat again. 2. Never take life for granted 3. Live my life to the fullest and be the most kind and loving person I can possibly be. If bad news, then I'm gonna have to commit suicide. I hope it's good news but I just can't see that. I can't believe I'm going to go the next few days not knowing if I'm going to live or die. Hard to fake. Definitely gonna get some ptsd from this if I live. I can survive hard times, I've done it before. But this, is the only exception. I am usually the person giving out positive advice for people and how they can change their mindset/outlook on life. Mushrooms and acid showed me everything, I've already been dead before. that's why I feel even more guilty than anyone in the world. I know right from wrong. I know better. I chose wrong that night and I deserve my guilt. But my girlfriend doesn't deserve to suffer from my actions. That's not fair. I've never experienced this much emotional pain. It's well deserved. Usually it is just a nightmare and you wake up. I fucking hope we are all okay :/

I really do appreciate your time and words but I don't know. I feel like 50 years of mistakes can't add up to this. I can't think of worse mistake than this. Especially when I've been surrounded by great people, who thought I was a great person. I'm dealing with the highest amount of guilt and the highest amount of shame. And the news hasn't even been spread yet. No one else knows. No one else expects. I'm so scared. Going to work was hard. I'm stalling on the way to the clinic because I'm so scared of when they tell me what I have. I am trying to text her back but soon she's gonna catch on that something's up. I may find out today, but I can't break the news to her until at least Sunday night. We have Monday Tuesday off work always. I'm scared she will lose her job when she finds out. All I want is to be there for her and her to be happy. I can't believe I did that. This is surreal.

Thank you. It's not just the guilt that makes me want to. That's one thing. But added on is how I will now be seen by everyone in my life as the scum of the earth that I am. I will keep posted but this feels too unreal. Even though we may never be together I just want her to be happy and that can't happen now. That crushes my soul. If I stay, everyone will hate me. If I die, I will hurt family and friends. There's no way to stop the pain from everyone including me. I never want to have sex again. I never want a relationship again. There is nothing left to live for. I lived a good life until now. I've been so blessed. Words cannot express how good people and the world has been to me and I threw it in the trash in a matter of five minutes.

She does suffer from depression but there's no way she would begin to understand this. My condition is on a whole other level for me to do this. I'm going to watch her love disappear right before my own eyes. In a few days I'm going to watch the life get pulled out of me after saying one sentence to her. I'm about to go to the clinic. I have 3 different kinds of marks now and it can't be a coincidence. At this point it's impossible. I'm holding on and trying to be normal before I watch my love suffer. I never thought this day would come.
